segments.text:
V. 10.
But the ax alſo already lieth—That is, There is no Room for ſuch idle Pretences. Speedy Execution is determined againſt all that do not repent. The Compariſon ſeems to be taken from a Woodman that has laid down his Ax, to put off his Coat, and then immediately goes to work to cut down the Tree. This refers to the wrath to come in the 7th Verſe. Is b•wn down—Inſtantly, without farther Delay.
